values.note: ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead, same day included for campsites. A 1-night campsite stay can be booked within 3 days of arrival. Maximum 14 continuous nights, then 48 hours away before registering again. Barnhart Island sites are reached through a tunnel under the Eisenhower Lock (13'6" clearance).
